program: A task board page: cards in To do, Doing and Done, added by typing a line (a title, #tags, +points), moved with arrows, renamed in place. Every change is an Edit kept in a history, so z undoes and y redoes. A focus timer counts down 25 minutes on one card and adds the time to it; the board saves to and loads from board.txt; tags and a search box filter what's shown.
